description: Fix deadlock where recoverBuildStageIssue() all-pass branch advances to Review without starting review pipeline

tasks.title: Fix all-pass recovery to resume review pipeline
tasks.description: In `recoverBuildStageIssue()` (agent-runner-service.ts:233-240), replace the bare `updateStage(Review)` with a full pipeline start. Save the existing `_workflowLogRepo` and `_coderSessionRepo` constructor params as class fields. Add `opencodeBinPath` as a new optional constructor param. In the all-pass branch: call `updateStage(Review)`, re-fetch the issue from repo, build `AcpConnectionOptions` from the stored fields, call `this.startPipeline()`. Check return value — if `{started: false}`, set issue to `Blocked`.
acceptanceCriteria: all-pass branch calls startPipeline() with correct issue (stage=Review), projectId, worktreePath, and acpOptions
If startPipeline returns {started: false}, issue is set to Blocked with error logged
Partial-pass branch behavior is unchanged (status=Blocked, no pipeline)
Constructor stores workflowLogRepo and coderSessionRepo as class fields (remove underscore prefix)
opencodeBinPath passed through constructor from server/index.ts
tasks.notes: server/index.ts:109 already passes workflowLogRepo and coderSessionRepo to the constructor — they just need to be stored instead of discarded. opencodeBinPath is resolved at line 82 and needs one more constructor argument. Use startPipeline (not resumePipeline) because it returns {started,error} instead of throwing and checks maxConcurrentAgents.

tasks.title: Test all-pass recovery resumes review pipeline
tasks.description: Write tests for `recoverBuildStageIssue()` covering: (1) all-pass → startPipeline called, stage becomes Review; (2) startPipeline returns {started:false} → issue Blocked; (3) partial-pass → issue Blocked, no pipeline call. Mock issueRepo, projectRepo, worktreeManager, and spy on startPipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: all-pass tasks.json triggers startPipeline with stage=Review issue
Test: startPipeline returning {started:false} falls back to Blocked status
Test: partial-pass does not call startPipeline, sets Blocked
tasks.notes: Check existing test patterns in packages/cli/tests/ for mock conventions.
